title: ageratina scopulorum
intro: Ageratina scopulorum, commonly known as Rocky Mountain Agueweed or Mountain Snakeroot, is a plant species native to the mountainous regions of North America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and fever. The therapeutic actions of Ageratina scopulorum include its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimalarial properties, which help alleviate symptoms associated with fever and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
